name: Haria Exports Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1970, Haria Exports Ltd is in the business of trading of Textile fabrics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HEL, part of the Haria Group, was engaged in manufacturing and selling textiles, fabrics, and ready-made garments, which were exported to markets such as the USA, UK, China, Nairobi, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, and other East African countries. Recognised as a government-approved trading house, it operated manufacturing units in Vapi and Kandla (Gujarat) with an installed capacity of 9.84 lakh units per annum. The company also had a presence in notebook production. However, it is currently not selling any products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.64 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.33% over last 3 years.
